def get_cell_color(r, c, size=6):
    """Get dominant color of a cell"""
    from collections import Counter
    colors = []
    for dr in range(size):
        for dc in range(size):
            colors.append(lines[r+dr][c+dc])
    return Counter(colors).most_common(1)[0][0]

def get_corners(r, c):

    lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')

# Let me understand the target patterns more carefully
# Each target is 6x6 with a 2x2 red center
# The "frame" around the red center is 2px wide on each side
# Let me extract the 4 corner 2x2 regions of each target

def get_corners(r, c):
    """Get the 4 corner 2x2 regions of a 6x6 target"""
    lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    tl = ''.join(lines[r+dr][c+dc] for dr in range(2) for dc in range(2))
    tr = ''.join(lines[r+dr][c+4+dc] for dr in range(2) for dc in range(2))
    bl = ''.join(lines[r+4+dr][c+dc] for dr in range(2) for dc in range(2))
    br = ''.join(lines[r+4+dr][c+4+dc] for dr in range(2) for dc in range(2))
    return {'TL': tl, 'TR': tr, 'BL': bl, 'BR': br}

print("TL target corners:", get_corners(10, 12))
print("TR target corners:", get_corners(10, 46))
print("BL target corners:", get_corners(44, 12))
print("BR target corners:", get_corners(44, 44))

# The center 2x2 is always RR
# Let me check the edge midpoints too
def get_edges(r, c):
    lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    top = ''.join(lines[r+2][c+2+dc] for dc in range(2))  # row 2, cols 2-3
    bot = ''.join(lines[r+3][c+2+dc] for dc in range(2))  # row 3, cols 2-3
    left = ''.join(lines[r+2+dr][c+2] for dr in range(2))  # col 2, rows 2-3
    right = ''.join(lines[r+2+dr][c+3] for dr in range(2))  # col 3, rows 2-3
    return {'top': top, 'bot': bot, 'left': left, 'right': right}

print("\nTL target edges:", get_edges(10, 12))
print("TR target edges:", get_edges(10, 46))
print("BL target edges:", get_edges(44, 12))
print("BR target edges:", get_edges(44, 44))

# Let me understand the target patterns more carefully
# Each target is 6x6 with a 2x2 red center
# The "frame" around the red center is 2px wide on each side
# Let me extract the 4 corner 2x2 regions of each target

def get_corners(r, c):
    """Get the 4 corner 2x2 regions of a 6x6 target"""
    lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    tl = ''.join(lines[r+dr][c+dc] for dr in range(2) for dc in range(2))
    tr = ''.join(lines[r+dr][c+4+dc] for dr in range(2) for dc in range(2))
    bl = ''.join(lines[r+4+dr][c+dc] for dr in range(2) for dc in range(2))
    br = ''.join(lines[r+4+dr][c+4+dc] for dr in range(2) for dc in range(2))
    return {'TL': tl, 'TR': tr, 'BL': bl, 'BR': br}

print("TL target corners:", get_corners(10, 12))
print("TR target corners:", get_corners(10, 46))
print("BL target corners:", get_corners(44, 12))
print("BR target corners:", get_corners(44, 44))

# The center 2x2 is always RR
# Let me check the edge midpoints too
def get_edges(r, c):
    lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    top = ''.join(lines[r+2][c+2+dc] for dc in range(2))  # row 2, cols 2-3
    bot = ''.join(lines[r+3][c+2+dc] for dc in range(2))  # row 3, cols 2-3
    left = ''.join(lines[r+2+dr][c+2] for dr in range(2))  # col 2, rows 2-3
    right = ''.join(lines[r+2+dr][c+3] for dr in range(2))  # col 3, rows 2-3
    return {'top': top, 'bot': bot, 'left': left, 'right': right}

print("\nTL target edges:", get_edges(10, 12))
print("TR target edges:", get_edges(10, 46))
print("BL target edges:", get_edges(44, 12))
print("BR target edges:", get_edges(44, 44))

lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')

def get_3x3_blocks(r, c):
    """Get 3x3 grid of 2x2 blocks for a 6x6 target"""
    blocks = []
    for bi in range(3):
        row = []
        for bj in range(3):

# Each target is 6x6 with a 2x2 red center

def get_corners(r, c):
    """Get the 4 corner 2x2 regions of a 6x6 target"""
    lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    tl = ''.join(lines[r+dr][c+dc] for dr in range(2) for dc in range(2))
    tr = ''.join(lines[r+dr][c+4+dc] for dr in range(2) for dc in range(2))

    br = ''.join(lines[r+4+dr][c+4+dc] for dr in range(2) for dc in range(2))
    return {'TL': tl, 'TR': tr, 'BL': bl, 'BR': br}

print("TL target corners:", get_corners(10, 12))

print("BL target corners:", get_corners(44, 12))
print("BR target corners:", get_corners(44, 44))

def get_edges(r, c):
    lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    top = ''.join(lines[r+2][c+2+dc] for dc in range(2))  # row 2, cols 2-3

    right = ''.join(lines[r+2+dr][c+3] for dr in range(2))  # col 3, rows 2-3
    return {'top': top, 'bot': bot, 'left': left, 'right': right}

print("\nTL target edges:", get_edges(10, 12))

def get_corners(r, c):
    """Get the 4 corner 2x2 regions of a 6x6 target"""
    lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    tl = ''.join(lines[r+dr][c+dc] for dr in range(2) for dc in range(2))
    tr = ''.join(lines[r+dr][c+4+dc] for dr in range(2) for dc in range(2))

    br = ''.join(lines[r+4+dr][c+4+dc] for dr in range(2) for dc in range(2))
    return {'TL': tl, 'TR': tr, 'BL': bl, 'BR': br}

def get_edges(r, c):
    lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')

    right = ''.join(lines[r+2+dr][c+3] for dr in range(2))  # col 3, rows 2-3
    return {'top': top, 'bot': bot, 'left': left, 'right': right}

def get_3x3_blocks(r, c):
    """Get 3x3 grid of 2x2 blocks for a 6x6 target"""
    blocks = []

def get_corners(r, c):
    """Get the 4 corner 2x2 regions of a 6x6 target"""
    lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    tl = ''.join(lines[r+dr][c+dc] for dr in range(2) for dc in range(2))

    br = ''.join(lines[r+4+dr][c+4+dc] for dr in range(2) for dc in range(2))
    return {'TL': tl, 'TR': tr, 'BL': bl, 'BR': br}

print("BL target corners:", get_corners(44, 12))

def get_edges(r, c):
    lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')

    return {'top': top, 'bot': bot, 'left': left, 'right': right}

# Let me understand the target patterns more carefully
# Each target is 6x6 with a 2x2 red center
# The "frame" around the red center is 2px wide on each side
# Let me extract the 4 corner 2x2 regions of each target

def get_corners(r, c):
    """Get the 4 corner 2x2 regions of a 6x6 target"""
    lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    tl = ''.join(lines[r+dr][c+dc] for dr in range(2) for dc in range(2))
    tr = ''.join(lines[r+dr][c+4+dc] for dr in range(2) for dc in range(2))
    bl = ''.join(lines[r+4+dr][c+dc] for dr in range(2) for dc in range(2))
    br = ''.join(lines[r+4+dr][c+4+dc] for dr in range(2) for dc in range(2))
    return {'TL': tl, 'TR': tr, 'BL': bl, 'BR': br}

print("TL target corners:", get_corners(10, 12))
print("TR target corners:", get_corners(10, 46))
print("BL target corners:", get_corners(44, 12))
print("BR target corners:", get_corners(44, 44))

# The center 2x2 is always RR
# Let me check the edge midpoints too
def get_edges(r, c):
    lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    top = ''.join(lines[r+2][c+2+dc] for dc in range(2))  # row 2, cols 2-3
    bot = ''.join(lines[r+3][c+2+dc] for dc in range(2))  # row 3, cols 2-3
    left = ''.join(lines[r+2+dr][c+2] for dr in range(2))  # col 2, rows 2-3
    right = ''.join(lines[r+2+dr][c+3] for dr in range(2))  # col 3, rows 2-3
    return {'top': top, 'bot': bot, 'left': left, 'right': right}

print("\nTL target edges:", get_edges(10, 12))
print("TR target edges:", get_edges(10, 46))
print("BL target edges:", get_edges(44, 12))
print("BR target edges:", get_edges(44, 44))

def get_corners(r, c):
    """Get the 4 corner 2x2 regions of a 6x6 target"""
    lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    tl = ''.join(lines[r+dr][c+dc] for dr in range(2) for dc in range(2))

    return {'TL': tl, 'TR': tr, 'BL': bl, 'BR': br}

print("BL target corners:", get_corners(44, 12))

def get_edges(r, c):

# Let me understand the target patterns more carefully
# Each target is 6x6 with a 2x2 red center
# The "frame" around the red center is 2px wide on each side
# Let me extract the 4 corner 2x2 regions of each target

def get_corners(r, c):
    """Get the 4 corner 2x2 regions of a 6x6 target"""
    lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    tl = ''.join(lines[r+dr][c+dc] for dr in range(2) for dc in range(2))
    tr = ''.join(lines[r+dr][c+4+dc] for dr in range(2) for dc in range(2))
    bl = ''.join(lines[r+4+dr][c+dc] for dr in range(2) for dc in range(2))
    br = ''.join(lines[r+4+dr][c+4+dc] for dr in range(2) for dc in range(2))
    return {'TL': tl, 'TR': tr, 'BL': bl, 'BR': br}

print("TL target corners:", get_corners(10, 12))
print("TR target corners:", get_corners(10, 46))
print("BL target corners:", get_corners(44, 12))
print("BR target corners:", get_corners(44, 44))

# The center 2x2 is always RR
# Let me check the edge midpoints too
def get_edges(r, c):
    lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    top = ''.join(lines[r+2][c+2+dc] for dc in range(2))  # row 2, cols 2-3
    bot = ''.join(lines[r+3][c+2+dc] for dc in range(2))  # row 3, cols 2-3
    left = ''.join(lines[r+2+dr][c+2] for dr in range(2))  # col 2, rows 2-3
    right = ''.join(lines[r+2+dr][c+3] for dr in range(2))  # col 3, rows 2-3
    return {'top': top, 'bot': bot, 'left': left, 'right': right}

print("\nTL target edges:", get_edges(10, 12))
print("TR target edges:", get_edges(10, 46))
print("BL target edges:", get_edges(44, 12))
print("BR target edges:", get_edges(44, 44))

# Each target is 6x6 with a 2x2 red center

def get_corners(r, c):
    """Get the 4 corner 2x2 regions of a 6x6 target"""
    lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    tl = ''.join(lines[r+dr][c+dc] for dr in range(2) for dc in range(2))
    tr = ''.join(lines[r+dr][c+4+dc] for dr in range(2) for dc in range(2))

    br = ''.join(lines[r+4+dr][c+4+dc] for dr in range(2) for dc in range(2))
    return {'TL': tl, 'TR': tr, 'BL': bl, 'BR': br}

print("TL target corners:", get_corners(10, 12))

print("BL target corners:", get_corners(44, 12))
print("BR target corners:", get_corners(44, 44))

# The center 2x2 is always RR

def get_edges(r, c):
    lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    top = ''.join(lines[r+2][c+2+dc] for dc in range(2))  # row 2, cols 2-3

    right = ''.join(lines[r+2+dr][c+3] for dr in range(2))  # col 3, rows 2-3
    return {'top': top, 'bot': bot, 'left': left, 'right': right}

print("\nTL target edges:", get_edges(10, 12))

def get_corners(r, c):

    return {'TL': tl, 'TR': tr, 'BL': bl, 'BR': br}

def get_edges(r, c):

def get_corners(r, c):
    """Get the 4 corner 2x2 regions of a 6x6 target"""
    lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    tl = ''.join(lines[r+dr][c+dc] for dr in range(2) for dc in range(2))
    tr = ''.join(lines[r+dr][c+4+dc] for dr in range(2) for dc in range(2))

    br = ''.join(lines[r+4+dr][c+4+dc] for dr in range(2) for dc in range(2))
    return {'TL': tl, 'TR': tr, 'BL': bl, 'BR': br}

def get_edges(r, c):

    right = ''.join(lines[r+2+dr][c+3] for dr in range(2))  # col 3, rows 2-3
    return {'top': top, 'bot': bot, 'left': left, 'right': right}

# Let me understand the target patterns more carefully
# Each target is 6x6 with a 2x2 red center
# The "frame" around the red center is 2px wide on each side
# Let me extract the 4 corner 2x2 regions of each target

def get_corners(r, c):
    """Get the 4 corner 2x2 regions of a 6x6 target"""
    lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    tl = ''.join(lines[r+dr][c+dc] for dr in range(2) for dc in range(2))
    tr = ''.join(lines[r+dr][c+4+dc] for dr in range(2) for dc in range(2))
    bl = ''.join(lines[r+4+dr][c+dc] for dr in range(2) for dc in range(2))
    br = ''.join(lines[r+4+dr][c+4+dc] for dr in range(2) for dc in range(2))
    return {'TL': tl, 'TR': tr, 'BL': bl, 'BR': br}

print("TL target corners:", get_corners(10, 12))
print("TR target corners:", get_corners(10, 46))
print("BL target corners:", get_corners(44, 12))
print("BR target corners:", get_corners(44, 44))

# The center 2x2 is always RR
# Let me check the edge midpoints too
def get_edges(r, c):
    lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    top = ''.join(lines[r+2][c+2+dc] for dc in range(2))  # row 2, cols 2-3
    bot = ''.join(lines[r+3][c+2+dc] for dc in range(2))  # row 3, cols 2-3
    left = ''.join(lines[r+2+dr][c+2] for dr in range(2))  # col 2, rows 2-3
    right = ''.join(lines[r+2+dr][c+3] for dr in range(2))  # col 3, rows 2-3
    return {'top': top, 'bot': bot, 'left': left, 'right': right}

print("\nTL target edges:", get_edges(10, 12))
print("TR target edges:", get_edges(10, 46))
print("BL target edges:", get_edges(44, 12))
print("BR target edges:", get_edges(44, 44))

# Let me understand the target patterns more carefully
# Each target is 6x6 with a 2x2 red center
# The "frame" around the red center is 2px wide on each side
# Let me extract the 4 corner 2x2 regions of each target

def get_corners(r, c):
    """Get the 4 corner 2x2 regions of a 6x6 target"""
    lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    tl = ''.join(lines[r+dr][c+dc] for dr in range(2) for dc in range(2))
    tr = ''.join(lines[r+dr][c+4+dc] for dr in range(2) for dc in range(2))
    bl = ''.join(lines[r+4+dr][c+dc] for dr in range(2) for dc in range(2))
    br = ''.join(lines[r+4+dr][c+4+dc] for dr in range(2) for dc in range(2))
    return {'TL': tl, 'TR': tr, 'BL': bl, 'BR': br}

print("TL target corners:", get_corners(10, 12))
print("TR target corners:", get_corners(10, 46))
print("BL target corners:", get_corners(44, 12))
print("BR target corners:", get_corners(44, 44))

# The center 2x2 is always RR
# Let me check the edge midpoints too
def get_edges(r, c):
    lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    top = ''.join(lines[r+2][c+2+dc] for dc in range(2))  # row 2, cols 2-3
    bot = ''.join(lines[r+3][c+2+dc] for dc in range(2))  # row 3, cols 2-3

    right = ''.join(lines[r+2+dr][c+3] for dr in range(2))  # col 3, rows 2-3
    return {'top': top, 'bot': bot, 'left': left, 'right': right}

print("\nTL target edges:", get_edges(10, 12))

print("BL target edges:", get_edges(44, 12))
print("BR target edges:", get_edges(44, 44))

def get_corners(r, c):
    """Get the 4 corner 2x2 regions of a 6x6 target"""
    lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    tl = ''.join(lines[r+dr][c+dc] for dr in range(2) for dc in range(2))

    return {'TL': tl, 'TR': tr, 'BL': bl, 'BR': br}

print("BL target corners:", get_corners(44, 12))

def get_edges(r, c):

    right = ''.join(lines[r+2+dr][c+3] for dr in range(2))  # col 3, rows 2-3
    return {'top': top, 'bot': bot, 'left': left, 'right': right}

def get_corners(r, c):

    lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')

    return {'TL': tl, 'TR': tr, 'BL': bl, 'BR': br}

def get_corners(r, c):
    """Get the 4 corner 2x2 regions of a 6x6 target"""
    lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    tl = ''.join(lines[r+dr][c+dc] for dr in range(2) for dc in range(2))

# Let me understand the target patterns more carefully
# Each target is 6x6 with a 2x2 red center
# The "frame" around the red center is 2px wide on each side
# Let me extract the 4 corner 2x2 regions of each target

def get_corners(r, c):
    """Get the 4 corner 2x2 regions of a 6x6 target"""
    lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    tl = ''.join(lines[r+dr][c+dc] for dr in range(2) for dc in range(2))
    tr = ''.join(lines[r+dr][c+4+dc] for dr in range(2) for dc in range(2))
    bl = ''.join(lines[r+4+dr][c+dc] for dr in range(2) for dc in range(2))
    br = ''.join(lines[r+4+dr][c+4+dc] for dr in range(2) for dc in range(2))
    return {'TL': tl, 'TR': tr, 'BL': bl, 'BR': br}

print("TL target corners:", get_corners(10, 12))
print("TR target corners:", get_corners(10, 46))
print("BL target corners:", get_corners(44, 12))
print("BR target corners:", get_corners(44, 44))

# The center 2x2 is always RR
# Let me check the edge midpoints too
def get_edges(r, c):
    lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    top = ''.join(lines[r+2][c+2+dc] for dc in range(2))  # row 2, cols 2-3
    bot = ''.join(lines[r+3][c+2+dc] for dc in range(2))  # row 3, cols 2-3
    left = ''.join(lines[r+2+dr][c+2] for dr in range(2))  # col 2, rows 2-3
    right = ''.join(lines[r+2+dr][c+3] for dr in range(2))  # col 3, rows 2-3
    return {'top': top, 'bot': bot, 'left': left, 'right': right}

print("\nTL target edges:", get_edges(10, 12))
print("TR target edges:", get_edges(10, 46))
print("BL target edges:", get_edges(44, 12))
print("BR target edges:", get_edges(44, 44))

def get_corners(r, c):
    """Get the 4 corner 2x2 regions of a 6x6 target"""
    lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    tl = ''.join(lines[r+dr][c+dc] for dr in range(2) for dc in range(2))

    return {'TL': tl, 'TR': tr, 'BL': bl, 'BR': br}

print("BL target corners:", get_corners(44, 12))

def get_edges(r, c):
    lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')

def get_corners(r, c):
    """Get the 4 corner 2x2 regions of a 6x6 target"""
    lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')

    return {'TL': tl, 'TR': tr, 'BL': bl, 'BR': br}

def get_edges(r, c):

def get_corners(r, c):
    """Get the 4 corner 2x2 regions of a 6x6 target"""
    lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    tl = ''.join(lines[r+dr][c+dc] for dr in range(2) for dc in range(2))

# Let me understand the target patterns more carefully
# Each target is 6x6 with a 2x2 red center
# The "frame" around the red center is 2px wide on each side
# Let me extract the 4 corner 2x2 regions of each target

def get_corners(r, c):
    """Get the 4 corner 2x2 regions of a 6x6 target"""
    lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    tl = ''.join(lines[r+dr][c+dc] for dr in range(2) for dc in range(2))
    tr = ''.join(lines[r+dr][c+4+dc] for dr in range(2) for dc in range(2))
    bl = ''.join(lines[r+4+dr][c+dc] for dr in range(2) for dc in range(2))
    br = ''.join(lines[r+4+dr][c+4+dc] for dr in range(2) for dc in range(2))
    return {'TL': tl, 'TR': tr, 'BL': bl, 'BR': br}

print("TL target corners:", get_corners(10, 12))
print("TR target corners:", get_corners(10, 46))
print("BL target corners:", get_corners(44, 12))
print("BR target corners:", get_corners(44, 44))

# The center 2x2 is always RR
# Let me check the edge midpoints too
def get_edges(r, c):
    lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    top = ''.join(lines[r+2][c+2+dc] for dc in range(2))  # row 2, cols 2-3
    bot = ''.join(lines[r+3][c+2+dc] for dc in range(2))  # row 3, cols 2-3
    left = ''.join(lines[r+2+dr][c+2] for dr in range(2))  # col 2, rows 2-3
    right = ''.join(lines[r+2+dr][c+3] for dr in range(2))  # col 3, rows 2-3
    return {'top': top, 'bot': bot, 'left': left, 'right': right}

print("\nTL target edges:", get_edges(10, 12))
print("TR target edges:", get_edges(10, 46))
print("BL target edges:", get_edges(44, 12))
print("BR target edges:", get_edges(44, 44))

# Each target is 6x6 with a 2x2 red center

# Let me extract the 4 corner 2x2 regions of each target

def get_corners(r, c):
    """Get the 4 corner 2x2 regions of a 6x6 target"""
    lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    tl = ''.join(lines[r+dr][c+dc] for dr in range(2) for dc in range(2))
    tr = ''.join(lines[r+dr][c+4+dc] for dr in range(2) for dc in range(2))

    br = ''.join(lines[r+4+dr][c+4+dc] for dr in range(2) for dc in range(2))
    return {'TL': tl, 'TR': tr, 'BL': bl, 'BR': br}

print("TL target corners:", get_corners(10, 12))

print("BL target corners:", get_corners(44, 12))
print("BR target corners:", get_corners(44, 44))

# The center 2x2 is always RR
# Let me check the edge midpoints too
def get_edges(r, c):
    lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    top = ''.join(lines[r+2][c+2+dc] for dc in range(2))  # row 2, cols 2-3

    right = ''.join(lines[r+2+dr][c+3] for dr in range(2))  # col 3, rows 2-3
    return {'top': top, 'bot': bot, 'left': left, 'right': right}

print("\nTL target edges:", get_edges(10, 12))

print("BL target edges:", get_edges(44, 12))

# Let me understand the target patterns more carefully
# Each target is 6x6 with a 2x2 red center
# The "frame" around the red center is 2px wide on each side
# Let me extract the 4 corner 2x2 regions of each target

def get_corners(r, c):
    """Get the 4 corner 2x2 regions of a 6x6 target"""
    lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    tl = ''.join(lines[r+dr][c+dc] for dr in range(2) for dc in range(2))
    tr = ''.join(lines[r+dr][c+4+dc] for dr in range(2) for dc in range(2))
    bl = ''.join(lines[r+4+dr][c+dc] for dr in range(2) for dc in range(2))
    br = ''.join(lines[r+4+dr][c+4+dc] for dr in range(2) for dc in range(2))
    return {'TL': tl, 'TR': tr, 'BL': bl, 'BR': br}

print("TL target corners:", get_corners(10, 12))
print("TR target corners:", get_corners(10, 46))
print("BL target corners:", get_corners(44, 12))
print("BR target corners:", get_corners(44, 44))

# The center 2x2 is always RR
# Let me check the edge midpoints too
def get_edges(r, c):
    lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    top = ''.join(lines[r+2][c+2+dc] for dc in range(2))  # row 2, cols 2-3
    bot = ''.join(lines[r+3][c+2+dc] for dc in range(2))  # row 3, cols 2-3

    right = ''.join(lines[r+2+dr][c+3] for dr in range(2))  # col 3, rows 2-3
    return {'top': top, 'bot': bot, 'left': left, 'right': right}

print("\nTL target edges:", get_edges(10, 12))
print("TR target edges:", get_edges(10, 46))
print("BL target edges:", get_edges(44, 12))
print("BR target edges:", get_edges(44, 44))
